rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly offers a Digital Teaching Resource; pages named for teaching or curriculum are academic learning resources.

fallback.rationale: The Meiji at 150 project shares historical scholarship, scholarly lectures and digitized archival evidence, including UBC collections and Vancouver Japanese Canadian history.
